description: The sum of hexanacci numbers from lo through hi. The sum from H(0) through H(10) is 32. lo must not pass hi. Each index runs from 0 to 512. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hexanacci-sum
